TopicEmbed.import_remote is invoked from the disqus thor task and RetrieveTopic job, which run before any PollFeed load, so Kernel#open would attempt a filesystem open of a URL string. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff, though runtime behavior in this codebase's environment isn't fully provable here.
